name: buchen.app – Online-Terminbuchung
author: buchen.app

sections.description:
Let customers book appointments online, right from your WordPress website.

buchen.app is a German-language online booking system for small businesses (German: Online-Terminbuchung, Buchungssystem). You add your services, prices and opening hours once and get your own booking page. Customers pick a free time and book without creating an account. Double bookings are blocked.

This plugin brings the booking button to your website. Enter the name of your booking page once, and every button on your site links there. If the name ever changes, you update it in one place.

Three ways to show the booking button

  • Block “Book appointment” for the block editor. The button takes the button style of your theme.
  • Shortcode [buchen_app] for the classic editor, widgets and page builders like Elementor or Divi.
  • Floating button in the corner of every page, so visitors can book from anywhere.

Design the button the way you like

  • Your own text, for example “Book now” or “Request appointment”.
  • Icon before or after the text: calendar, calendar with check mark, clock, check mark or arrow.
  • Colors from your theme or your own, corners from square to round, font size and padding.
  • Style “Fill” or “Outline”, full width, alignment left, center or right.
  • Open the booking page in the same tab or a new one.
  • Floating button: text, icon, color, corners, left or right, on phones, computers or both. The text color adjusts itself so it stays readable.

Privacy friendly

  • No cookies, no tracking, no scripts or iframes from buchen.app on your pages.
  • Your visitors only connect to buchen.app when they click a button.
  • No links or credits on your site that you did not add yourself.

Made for businesses with appointments

Hairdressers, beauty salons, dog groomers, physiotherapists, massage practices, foot care, naturopaths, personal trainers, photographers, tattoo studios, car detailers, car workshops and many more. The booking page shows only free times and sends confirmations and reminders by email.

In German

The plugin is ready for translation. German translations, formal and informal, come through translate.wordpress.org.

External services

This plugin links to the online booking service buchen.app. It is needed to show your booking page to your visitors.

  • When you save the settings page, WordPress sends one request to https://buchen.app/<name> to check that the booking page exists. The request contains the name you entered. Like every request from WordPress, it also contains the address of your website (in the user agent) and the IP address of your server. Nothing else is sent, and no request is made at any other time.
  • When a visitor clicks a button, the browser opens the booking page on buchen.app. Until that click, no data of your visitors is sent to buchen.app.
  • Links in the admin area lead to the registration and the login of buchen.app. They are only opened when you click them.

The service is provided by buchen.app: Terms of service, Privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin under Plugins > Add New and activate it.
  2. No account yet? Register for free at buchen.app and add your services and times.
  3. Go to Settings > buchen.app and enter the name of your booking page, for example my-salon for https://buchen.app/my-salon. You can also paste the full link.
  4. Save. The plugin checks once that the booking page exists.
  5. Add the block “Book appointment” to a page, use the shortcode [buchen_app], or switch on the floating button.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account on buchen.app?

Yes. The plugin places the booking button on your website. Your services, times and bookings are managed in your buchen.app account. The Free plan has no end date.

Where do I find the name of my booking page?

It is the part after buchen.app/ in the link to your booking page. You chose it when you created your account.

Does the button match my theme?

Yes. The block and the shortcode use the button style of your theme. In the block you can change text, icon, colors, corners, font size and padding.

Which options does the shortcode have?

[buchen_app text=”Book now” icon=”calendar” icon_position=”after” style=”outline” new_tab=”yes”]. Icons: calendar-check, calendar, clock, check, arrow. All options are optional.

What happens if no booking page is set?

The buttons stay hidden on your website. In the block editor you see a hint with a link to the settings.

Does the plugin need a cookie notice?

The plugin itself sets no cookies and sends no data while your visitors browse your site. Your visitors only reach buchen.app when they click a button. What happens on the booking page is described in the privacy policy of buchen.app.

Can developers change the link?

Yes, with the filter buchen_app_booking_url. It receives the link and the name of the booking page.
